data.long_meaning: Arsad is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Arsha', meaning 'king' or 'lord'. The suffix 'd' is added, making the name signify the 'Lord of the Mountain'. This name is associated with strength, power, and a connection to nature. The name Arsad carries the meaning “Lord of the Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arsad usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
